body:
# Rick's Quality of Life

This is an opinionated, open-source data pack to improve quality of life in vanilla Minecraft single-player gameplay.

Source code is on [GitHub](https://github.com/rlan/quality-of-life).
See the [wiki](https://github.com/rlan/quality-of-life/wiki) for changes made to the vanilla game.


## Prerequisite

Minecraft Java Edition 1.14 or later.


## Feedback

See [issues](https://github.com/rlan/quality-of-life/issues).
